scope: Plan the stage after completion and preservation of current static analysis; no device action or product modification

world.arithmetic: sRGB code values; no per-image normalization
world.configuration_scope: Baseline world only. A genuinely different supported viewport/pixel scale needs a new analytic source manifest at that exact world/raster. Source points retain physical logical scale with center(width/2,height/2); no screenshot/source stretching.

source_shapes.composition: 4 families x3 base radii x3 area-preserving aspect ratios x3 orientations=108 geometry conditions; six ordered palettes use fixed family/factor marginal balance;6 nonoverlapping shapes per plate
source_shapes.orientation: All families, including elliptic circle-family instances, use registered0,pi/4,pi/2. Seed-controlled source jitter never changes angle or fixed palette table.

anchors.jitter_pt: independent uniform[-2,+2] in x and y from the assigned registered source seed, before any output; exact coordinates retained
anchors.spacing: 72pt nominal nearest-center spacing; max radial bound25.456pt plus2pt independent jitter leaves more than4pt source-boundary clearance. Verify actual ideal bounds and retain any failure; never substitute a seed.
anchors.center_policy: The listed center is baseline375x667pt only; a separately registered genuine viewport uses(width/2,height/2), preserving offsets and point-scale source geometry, never scaling the field.

backgrounds.formula_status: must be fully declared and frozen before generation
must be fully declared and frozen before generation

source_shapes.design_limit: fixed central constellation and targeted backgrounds; disjoint seeds do not establish design blindness or natural-scene representativeness

palette_classes.meaning: six ordered internal three-color fills with fixed deterministic family and geometry-factor marginal balance across108 conditions; not a full palette Cartesian cross or background-independent design

source_shapes.circle_boundary: unit analytic disk transformed by the exact registered area-preserving aspect/scale/rotation affine matrix; save resulting conic and actual support

asymmetric_polygon.normalization: divide local base vertices by max Euclidean vertex norm, then apply registered source affine transform
asymmetric_polygon.support: base unit vertices normalized to1; actual transformed support radius computed and recorded, not assumed equal to base_radius

internal_color_partition.coordinate: base local coordinate u before aspect/scale/world rotation/translation, with unit-radius boundary; thresholds u=-.25,+.25; apply same registered affine map to shape and color partition
internal_color_partition.membership: each band intersects the exact ideal shape support
internal_color_partition.rgb_assignment: palette class indices in left,middle,right order
internal_color_partition.boundary_metadata: exact clipped local/world boundary segments, each with persistent segment ID, adjacent RGB regions and any multiple intervals

coverage_contract.per_region_encoding: lossless integer subpixel-count RLE, denominator16, each color region separate
coverage_contract.shape_coverage: sum of three region counts divided by16; per-region counts divided by16 are exact declared sampled masks
coverage_contract.rgb_composition: sum16 shape/background sRGB code values, then half-up integer division(integer_sum+8)//16; no normalization
coverage_contract.freeze_policy: register analytic/rasterization implementation and dependencies before input generation; preserve and hash-bind actual mask bytes before reading any dynamic test outputs
coverage_contract.area_moments: per-region and aggregate source area and coverage-weighted output pixel-center moments, distinct from continuous/native-response moments
coverage_contract.status: not generated or frozen by this draft; generator/background formulas still implementation tasks

source_shapes.count_semantics: 108 registered geometry conditions across18 source plates per split, NOT108 or216 large markers in one image

source_transform.formula: world=c+R(theta)*base_radius*diag(sqrt(q),1/sqrt(q))*v, q in[1,1.5,2] is the registered area-preserving SOURCE aspect transform. Applies to shape and all internal color regions only.
source_transform.scale_meaning: base_radius is the pre-anisotropy unit-support radius; do not call it the final circumradius. Save actual transformed maximum radius, bounds, area and moments.
source_transform.circle_family: q=1 is circle; q!=1 is its exact ellipse-family instance, retain analytic conic. Do not label every instance a circle.
source_transform.native_rule: Never nonuniformly stretch or screenshot-scale a native control. Source anisotropy is an optical stimulus only.
source_transform.grouping: plate=floor(i/6), slot=i mod6.18 plates of6. This enumerates all geometry conditions; no geometry rejected/selected from output.
source_transform.source_seed_assignment: plate_index mod2 selects the registered split source-layout seed; no claim both seeds replicate every geometry condition
source_transform.background_assignment: plate_index mod3 chooses one registered background per captured plate in size-coverage extension; extra backdrop coverage requires another bounded plan
source_transform.aspect_semantics: Three distinct aspect levels1,1.5,2, with orientation as a separate factor. For circle-family instances these are principal axis ratios; actual world-axis bounds/width-height ratio and principal axes are computed per transformed family. Do not confuse affine factor with every polygon bbox ratio.

palette_assignment.balance_claim: Global each class18; each family every class4or5; every scale/aspect/orientation level each class6. Fixed table, no seed permutation and no output selection.
palette_assignment.not_independent: Existing plate mod3 background blocks are correlated with palette: rows are retained explicitly. No background-within-palette balance or independent scene/color claim; do not enlarge the108-condition matrix to hide this limitation.

rng: NumPy Generator PCG64, dependency versions frozen before generation

splits.policy: Calibration fixes instrumentation/tracker/candidate; freeze before test outputs are opened. Any output-driven revision reclassifies that test as calibration and requires new seeds.

T_controlled_native_optical_transport.native_parent: original system-rendered TabView Dock, retained identities and unmodified native size/style
T_controlled_native_optical_transport.internal_shape_origin: native system rendering; measure separately from commanded carrier
not_claimed: native gesture law from a fixture curve
equivalence to moving source or different public glass specimen
T_controlled_native_optical_transport.feasibility_gate: Calibration must verify stationary-source live sampling, retained parent identities, actual presentation geometry, clipping and no snapshot/fallback; if infeasible, mark unavailable rather than force private internals.

I_native_internal_interaction.internal_lens: system controlled; no direct internal-lens positioning or programmatic selection masquerading as touch
I_native_internal_interaction.android: same registered input intention, independent actual delivery trace and response; never drive internal Android lens by observed native lens positions
I_native_internal_interaction.scope: All seven genuine native families use their own registered real input suites with a fixed owning carrier; no family is inferred from Dock alone.

carrier_paths.dock_size: observed native rest bounding box W/H, never forced to a candidate's dimensions
carrier_paths.anchor_halfspan: a=74*abs(u.x)+38*abs(u.y)+18*sqrt(2); covers3x2 center offsets, maximum2pt source jitter and maximum transformed source radius
carrier_paths.clip_policy: retain unavoidable carrier edge clipping and visible support; no Dock resizing
carrier_paths.phase_labels: approach/pass/leave from achieved presentation geometry and source support; planned phases retained separately
carrier_paths.reset_policy: explicit discontinuity; keep reset in frame/event ledger with phase label; never call fixture reset native launch/rebound
carrier_paths.core_progress_curve: For each moving segment, s=start+(end-start)*(10z^3-15z^4+6z^5), with local normalized z; fixture carrier only, not native gesture law
carrier_paths.achievement_policy: Record actual presentation/timing; commanded profile is no guarantee of driver delivery or display/capture rate
carrier_paths.anchor_constellation: six anchors per plate,3x2 offsets[-72,0,72]x[-36,36]pt, bounded jitter2pt per axis; maximum transformed radius18sqrt2pt
carrier_paths.duration_semantics: 6seconds is INITIAL ROUND recording budget, never the definition of a complete action. Preserve start/end, all actual frames, release and observed settle. If unsettled/cut-off mark incomplete and require bounded extension/independent remeasurement before completeness claim.
carrier_paths.center_policy: Use registered actual viewport center(width/2,height/2); baseline center_pt is not imposed on other viewports.

native_input_cases.resets: actual native interactions with individual markers

native_input_cases.then: release after each, trace actual delivery

native_input_cases.path: interrupt prior native transition with next real input
native_input_cases.cancel: only if public input driver supports it

core_T.axes: initial stratified eight-direction screen with8 registered plates of6; all three factor levels present, only48/108 geometry conditions screened

native_I.axes: one clip per combined native input case
native_I.duration_semantics: initial6s only; each complete subevent requires preinput-through-settle support, else split/extend under finite ledger
native_I.case_identity: global_case_index=configuration_global_index*7+suite_index; baseline Dock index0 yields g=0..6, same as staged schedule

bounded_matrix.repeat_controls: none implicit; two reserved clips only for recorded acquisition-failure diagnosis or a paired repeat, originals retained
bounded_matrix.limit: Initial64-clip screen only. It cannot establish full size/configuration/action coverage or complete settling. Mandatory later stages below are separately budgeted.
bounded_matrix.expansion_policy: Mandatory finite size/control coverage before corresponding completeness claims; uncertainty extensions separately registered. No unlimited Cartesian multiplication of geometry,palette,backdrop,theme,direction,speed.
bounded_matrix.new_family_color_policy: Every registered condition has three internal color regions;18 plates with6 landmarks, never all108/216 crowded onto one source. Palette is balanced, not fully crossed.

geometry_trace.clock: single monotonic app clock per process; retain separate host/video clock domains
geometry_trace.presentation_limit: CALayer.presentation is approximate in-flight state, can be unavailable, and is not a per-pixel compositor timestamp
geometry_trace.velocity_acceleration: derive from actual irregular geometry samples using calibration-frozen method; preserve gaps and uncertainty

measured_edge_contract.method: freeze the edge extraction/measurement method on calibration; relate any pixel-derived edge to originalPTS and app-clock mapping; public presentation geometry remains separately labeled
measured_edge_contract.unknown: an unknown curved native edge remains null; never substitute a bounding-box side or candidate assumed capsule and call it measured
measured_edge_contract.scope: All registered actual components across seven families; public presentation and pixel-observed geometry remain separately labeled. Component unavailable/nonexistent/occluded is a status with null geometry, never a manufactured edge.
measured_edge_contract.instance_scope: layers[] lists category templates; every measured edge/corner row also binds actual component_instance_id and generation/parent; expand all repeated instances via native_component_instance_contract

capture_time_contract.clock_mapping: visible synchronization patch outside measurement ROI plus draw brackets, preserve mapping/residual/drift uncertainty; never assume one-frame latency
capture_time_contract.screenshots: retain request/completion brackets, actual sampling time support and missing frames
capture_time_contract.resolution_limit: 60fps is about16.7ms/frame and120fps about8.3ms/frame, not every millisecond; report achieved PTS spacing
capture_time_contract.unobserved_frames: never synthesize and label measured; any comparison resampling explicitly reports interpolation/support/uncertainty
capture_time_contract.cross_device_comparison: elapsed intervals from observed delivery/visual markers, not wall-clock synchronization
capture_time_contract.all_actual_frames_required: One frame-ledger entry for EVERY recorded sample in original PTS order, plus explicit gaps/repeated/failed/undecodable frames. All registered source/feature/control IDs retain status per actual frame, including null/unidentified/occluded/clipped. Keyframes are only a visualization selection, never the analyzed sample.
capture_time_contract.completeness: Every captured actual frame from pre-input baseline through all delivered subevents, release/cancel and observed settle; initial6s is not completeness.

dynamic_tracker.status: must be separately implemented/self-tested/frozen before test outputs are read; static v2 is not automatically valid
dynamic_tracker.source_identity: registered shape/color/context, never forced nearest neighbor
dynamic_tracker.no_disappearance_shortcut: weak retained templates do not prove absence across full support
dynamic_tracker.limits: observed morphology, not physical unblurred shape/IOR/thickness or universal topology recovery

local_image_stretch.identity: persistent IDs for each source outer boundary, polygon vertex, clipped internal-color-boundary segment and sampled feature position
local_image_stretch.supported_input: reliable source-to-observed boundary/internal-color-boundary correspondence; plausible centroid or whole-shape ellipse fit is insufficient
local_image_stretch.one_dimensional: resolved contour neighborhood yields source-contour tangent length ratio/direction only; unsupported normal stretch remains null
local_image_stretch.two_dimensional: fit local source-to-observed Jacobian J only for a sufficiently supported non-collinear feature neighborhood passing calibration-frozen conditioning/residual gates
local_image_stretch.measurement_meaning: apparent local image deformation, not physical material strain or native renderer inversion

edge_frame.requirements: Confidently located measured native/candidate family/component edge with matched time support. Source-contour tangent differs from that edge tangent; unavailable/no-refraction component does not invent image stretch.
edge_frame.normal_ratio: norm(J*n) when both J and edge frame supported, otherwise null
edge_frame.tangent_ratio: norm(J*tau) when both J and edge frame supported, otherwise null
edge_frame.directions: directions of J*n and J*tau in the shared world frame, with uncertainty

local_image_stretch.unknown_policy: retain every registered feature at each supported sample; fused,occluded,clipped,low-contrast,unidentified or ambiguous multi-component evidence remains null with reasons, never force one local stretch
forbidden_inference: global area change as local strain
one-dimensional tangent evidence as a full2D field
bounding-box side as measured curved edge
unique physical thickness from image-response curves
time stretching or filling unobserved gaps
local_image_stretch.budget: Analyze every actual frame on demand from retained clips. Full-frame analysis adds no acquisition by itself; mandatory size/control and bounded unsettle continuations have their own registered budgets beyond the initial64x6 screen.

comparison.T: conditional optical response at matched achieved carrier pose; not validation of native motion timing
comparison.I: independent response to delivered input; include delay/travel/lift/fall/release/rebound/interruption/settling
forbidden_alignment: dynamic time warping to hide mismatch
feeding native internal-lens trajectory to Android as its response
comparison.aggregate_unit: source seed/clip with paired backdrop, direction and theme blocks; pixels and frames are correlated
comparison.threshold_status: not defined in draft; must derive repeatability/uncertainty on calibration, predeclare tolerances then freeze before test
comparison.claim_limit: no99.99%, every-millisecond equality, universal scene guarantee, or physical native inversion

preservation.storage: Retain complete original source recordings and original PTS. Stream-decode/analyze ALL actual frames, retaining compact per-frame rows/status and declared lossless ROI/visualization samples, not full-screen PNG dumps. Visual keyframes are supplemental only. Measure bytes/second and bound per-stage storage before capture.
preservation.codec_limit: lossy video and lossless screenshots remain separately labeled; codec-distorted color is not a lossless screen measurement

followup_parameter_space.execution: on demand only after identified failure or uncertainty; no full Cartesian matrix by default
followup_parameter_space.native_rebound_policy: valid native outcome; never add a fixture spring to manufacture it
followup_parameter_space.settling_limit_policy: If not settled at initial6s, retain original as incomplete/right-censored. Before claiming complete, register one paired native/Android remeasurement of entire same sequence including preinput with cap12s, or a separately identified continuation with explicit clock continuity limits. At12s if still not settled/trackable, retain incomplete and stop automatic repeats.
followup_parameter_space.budget: Initial64x6 is a first-round budget only. Mandatory size/control coverage and<=12s incomplete-action continuation need separately registered finite ledgers; no silent truncation or Cartesian expansion.

checks: preinput-to-settle completeness or explicit bounded continuation need
paired_feasibility.failure_policy: stop affected arm and diagnose before launching coverage; retain original failed clips
paired_feasibility.duration_semantics: Initial6s screen; unresolved action remains incomplete and cannot pass the full-action gate merely because recording stopped.

revision_summary: Draft v4 only: preserves v3 exact bytes; fixes deterministic family and geometry-factor palette balance within108 conditions, separates real body_size/layout/content axes with baseline index0 and honest intrinsic Toggle, extends I/all-frame/component/layer contracts to7 families, and revises finite staged suite-slot accounting. Static first; no generation/capture/test decoding.

stage_T_size_extension.required_before: claim all registered source sizes/aspect ratios/orientations were dynamically checked
stage_T_size_extension.direction_assignment: plate_index mod8 maps to E,W,N,S,NE,NW,SE,SW, except eight initial plates retain their already registered direction. Each plate has one full varying-speed/reversal profile; untested condition-by-direction crosses stay untested.
stage_T_size_extension.background_source_theme: same fixed paired assignments across renderers; plate mod2 source; plate mod3 background; plate mod2 theme unless initial registered block says otherwise
stage_T_size_extension.scope: All108 geometric conditions covered once per split; no claim every condition has all8 directions/backgrounds/palettes.

stage_I_core_controls.required_before: claim core controls received separately registered actual body-size/layout/content and complete-action coverage
stage_I_core_controls.definition: 26 configurations x7 suites=182 per renderer/split; baseline index0 makes same g=0..6 reusable. Variable-body families need3 actual measured body sizes; Toggle needs1 fixed intrinsic size. Unsupported rows remain explicit and cannot satisfy a gate.

stage_I_other_controls.required_before: claim every requested native glass-control family received applicable component/axis/action coverage
stage_I_other_controls.scope: Family-specific actions and all-frame body/popup/sheet/button contracts; no fabricated native slider gesture or silently substituted sizing. Three body sizes still require public-support measurement.

mandatory_size_coverage.ledger_policy: 1392 is a finite staged nominal suite-slot upper plan (64 initial+40 T+700 core I+588 other I), not acquisition authorization or an absolute raw-recording cap. Complete static then calibration feasibility; register small batches with measured throughput/storage. Any atomic split needed for complete actions adds actual clip counts/duration only under a finite amended ledger. One paired<=12s incomplete-condition remeasurement/continuation uses its own ledger; preserve originals. No full Cartesian multiplication. Exact full-identity initial I reuse is conditional; zero valid reuse gives conservative1420 nominal slots (add at most28), not an unlimited expansion.

native_I_balanced_assignment.configuration_order: family_order then each family configurations[]; baseline body_size.base is configuration_index0 and first; stable explicit configuration_global_index0..46
native_I_balanced_assignment.initial_reuse: Dock.body_size.base has configuration_global_index0, so seven initial I cases are exactly g0..6 with same source/background/theme/config identities; no index-shift reuse
native_I_balanced_assignment.paired_renderers: exact same frozen condition/configuration/suite identity; independent actual delivery and response
native_I_balanced_assignment.balance_limit: Deterministic blocking, not exact independence or all-source/configuration/background/palette Cartesian coverage. Unsupported entries preserve their planned IDs; no compacting/reindexing after support decisions.
native_I_balanced_assignment.unit: nominal complete suite slot; atomic splits and durations require a finite amended ledger before acquisition

mandatory_size_coverage.combined_nominal_suite_slots_assumption: All28 initial I slots (7 cases x2renderers x2splits) meet exact full-identity reuse gate; otherwise add up to28, conservative1420 before atomic splits/followups.

native_configuration_registry.measurement_policy: Record public API/controlSize/constraints, actual intrinsic/model/presentation bounds and corner geometry, actual thumb/track/fill/popup dimensions, viewport/safe area/pixel scale, orientation, Dynamic Type, item count/content IDs, native parent/material/OS. Requested target is not measured geometry. No nonuniform native transform, screenshot scaling or fabricated capsule.

separate_axes_contract.body_size: Variable-body families require three actually measured distinct small/base/large body extents using genuinely supported public sizing, holding content/layout baseline where possible. Baseline is configuration index0. The draft contains targets only, not measured sizes. If unavailable/ignored/coupled, preserve evidence and narrow the claim; no label/count variants or scaled screenshots may substitute.
separate_axes_contract.size_distinctness: Freeze measurement tolerance on calibration before outputs; classify small/base/large by measured relevant body extent beyond uncertainty, record both width/height and which dimension varies. Three target requests with equal realized bounds do not satisfy the gate. Intrinsic thumb sizes are independently measured and may be equal.
separate_axes_contract.layout: At most two nonbaseline supported layout variants; body request and content baseline. Preserve every actual coupled size/trait change and do not call it an independent body-size sample.
separate_axes_contract.content: At most two nonbaseline content variants; body request and layout baseline. Preserve induced body/layout change; no substitution for required body_size rows.
separate_axes_contract.crossing: One baseline +2 body-size +2 layout +2 content for variable-body candidates, at most7 planned configurations; fixed-intrinsic Toggle1+2+2=5. No3x3x3 Cartesian cross. No unsupported config disappears or is replaced.
separate_axes_contract.status: unmeasured_draft; support classification, actual bounds and finite acquisition ledger must be frozen after calibration feasibility and before test
separate_axes_contract.size_exception: An actual public fixed/discrete-size limitation requires measured support evidence and explicit unsupported row/reason, a revised finite schedule and a scoped claim. This is not a pass of the three-size gate or an assumption that every family can be arbitrarily resized.

native_configuration_registry.dual_head_slider: No public native dual-thumb API is presumed. Two actual native single sliders must be labeled paired-single-slider composition, with both component IDs/complete frame traces. Preserve app dual-head goal separately; this seven-family schedule is not a fake native dual-head equivalence or an extra acquisition authorization.
native_configuration_registry.viewport_source_policy: For a different genuine native viewport/scale regenerate analytic source raster at that actual world geometry and sampling contract under a separate frozen manifest. Preserve logical shape coordinates/scale/aspect/color masks and native pixel scale; do not resample or nonuniformly fit old source/screenshot.

Dock.body_size_plan: Keep4 baseline items, labels, selection, style and Dynamic Type fixed. Try genuinely supported public viewport/parent widths320/375/414pt to obtain measured small/base/large Dock bodies; register resulting world/raster. Item count3/5 belongs only to content, never body_size.
Dock.layout_plan: Supported placement/safe-area or RTL layout; keep body request and content baseline.
Dock.content_plan: Longer labels at baseline item count; alternate item count while body request/layout baseline.
Dock.actual_size_evidence_status: not_measured; no size-coverage claim in this draft

segmented_Tab.body_size_plan: Keep3 baseline short segments and style fixed. Public width constraints160/240/320pt or genuine supported native controlSize may provide small/base/large; freeze one supported sizing route and actual bounds. Changing segment count or title length is not a size sample.
segmented_Tab.layout_plan: Supported RTL or placement/layout configuration, same content and baseline body request.
segmented_Tab.content_plan: Long titles at same3 segments; alternate segment count2or5 with body request/layout baseline.
segmented_Tab.actual_size_evidence_status: not_measured; no size-coverage claim in this draft

Toggle.body_size_plan: Native Toggle/UISwitch has fixed intrinsic body size in this reference. Record exactly one true body-size baseline, including actual thumb bounds. Never scale it or relabel long-label/accessibility layouts as small/base/large bodies.
Toggle.layout_plan: Supported RTL or placement/layout alternatives, same switch API/content and native intrinsic body request.
Toggle.content_plan: Long label and accessibility-content alternatives; intrinsic switch/ thumb may remain equal and must be recorded honestly.
Toggle.actual_size_evidence_status: not_measured; no size-coverage claim in this draft

single_slider.body_size_plan: Same range,value,ticks,label,style. Public rail-length constraints160/240/320pt target three genuinely measured body widths. Thumb intrinsic size may remain equal and is recorded separately; never call rail length a thumb-size change.
single_slider.layout_plan: Supported RTL or public placement/layout, same content and baseline body request.
single_slider.content_plan: Supported long labels or tick-content variations with body request/layout baseline.
single_slider.actual_size_evidence_status: not_measured; no size-coverage claim in this draft

single_choice_menu.body_size_plan: Keep exactly the same five language labels/order/selection and native style. Probe supported public presentation/viewport constraints for distinct small/base/large popup bodies; OS may refuse/ignore requested size. No undocumented popup-width setter is presumed. If three real body sizes are unavailable, retain unsupported sizing rows and narrow the size claim; long labels/item counts cannot fill those rows.
single_choice_menu.layout_plan: Supported trigger placement/RTL/safe-area alternatives, same labels and baseline body request; record popup coupling.
single_choice_menu.content_plan: Long labels at same5 items; alternative supported item count with body request/layout baseline.
single_choice_menu.actual_size_evidence_status: not_measured; no size-coverage claim in this draft

dialog_or_half_sheet.body_size_plan: Choose one actual public native presentation subtype per registered configuration block. Hold text/actions/style fixed and use supported public detent/presentation constraints for measured small/base/large body extents. Sheet detents and dialog subtypes remain labeled; a dialog is not declared covered by a sheet. Unsupported resizing stays explicit.
dialog_or_half_sheet.layout_plan: Supported placement/size-class/layout alternatives, same content and baseline body request; record coupled body change.
dialog_or_half_sheet.content_plan: Long text and accessibility text/content alternatives, same body request/layout; record intrinsic-size coupling.
dialog_or_half_sheet.actual_size_evidence_status: not_measured; no size-coverage claim in this draft

native_button.body_size_plan: Hold title,image,state,public style and parent fixed. Use supported public controlSize or width/height constraints to obtain measured small/base/large bodies; freeze actual API route and do not swap styles or titles to manufacture sizes.
native_button.layout_plan: Supported RTL/placement/content-layout alternatives, same title and baseline body request.
native_button.content_plan: Long title and supported accessibility-content alternatives with body request/layout baseline; record intrinsic-size coupling.
native_button.actual_size_evidence_status: not_measured; no size-coverage claim in this draft

measurement_gate_math.scope: Only distinct actual body-size support. This scalar gate is not a dynamic edge/corner/appearance validator or proof of native rendering.

complete_action_contract.scope: Every captured actual frame from pre-input baseline through all delivered subevents, release/cancel and observed settle; initial6s is not completeness.
complete_action_contract.settling: Freeze a geometry/appearance stability criterion and uncertainty on calibration, including >=.5s stable observed support. A missing edge/clock/observation cannot be silently called settled.
complete_action_contract.full_frame_analysis: One frame-ledger entry for EVERY recorded sample in original PTS order, plus explicit gaps/repeated/failed/undecodable frames. All registered source/feature/control IDs retain status per actual frame, including null/unidentified/occluded/clipped. Keyframes are only a visualization selection, never the analyzed sample.
complete_action_contract.subevent_policy: Do not start the next bundled subevent until prior settle observed or label overlap as intentional interruption. Preserve each preinput/action/release/settle boundary. If a suite cannot fit6s, split into independently complete registered clips or use bounded12s continuation; never truncate and call complete.
complete_action_contract.bounded_continuation: If not settled at initial6s, retain original as incomplete/right-censored. Before claiming complete, register one paired native/Android remeasurement of entire same sequence including preinput with cap12s, or a separately identified continuation with explicit clock continuity limits. At12s if still not settled/trackable, retain incomplete and stop automatic repeats.
complete_action_contract.continuation_budget: At most one paired continuation per flagged condition under a separately registered clip/footage/storage ledger, reviewed after each small batch. It is outside the initial64x6 budget and not an unlimited retry permission.
complete_action_contract.not_every_millisecond: Actual frames have PTS/codec/color/time-support limitations; no assertion every millisecond or unrecorded compositor frame was measured.
complete_action_contract.component_scope: Every native family/configuration uses native_component_frame_contract for all actual frames and every planned component ID, not only Dock/lens.

native_component_frame_contract.scope: All seven native families, every registered configuration and every actually recorded frame from baseline through settle or explicit incomplete. Track real body/thumb/track/fill/highlight/popup/sheet/button components when present; not only Dock.
native_component_frame_contract.existence_policy: Component lists are observation targets, not claims every component has a separate native glass node or public getter. Record present,not_in_native_api,not_exposed,not_visible,occluded,clipped,unidentified,decode_failed with null reason where appropriate; preserve all planned IDs each actual frame. No private API or geometry mutation.
native_component_frame_contract.geometry_policy: Record actual requested/model/presentation/pixel-observed bounds, shape/corners, transforms, opacity/fill response separately with acquisition method and time support. Unknown curved edges/corner radius remain null; no assumed ellipse/capsule/bbox substitution.
native_component_frame_contract.layer_policy: Record actual parent,z-order,material ancestors and intervening frosted backplate per component. The selected thumb/lens sees the composited backing material and content actually below it; never compare a foreground lens as though it bypasses a backplate. Unsupported backdrop visibility remains explicit.
native_component_frame_contract.optical_policy: Source-feature correspondence, edge-frame deformation and foreground fill/labels are separated for every supported refractive component. An opaque/no-refraction component retains appearance/geometry evidence and no fabricated optical measurement.
native_component_frame_contract.all_frame_policy: One frame-ledger entry for EVERY recorded sample in original PTS order, plus explicit gaps/repeated/failed/undecodable frames. All registered source/feature/control IDs retain status per actual frame, including null/unidentified/occluded/clipped. Keyframes are only a visualization selection, never the analyzed sample.
native_component_frame_contract.instance_contract: native_component_instance_contract; category37 is not an actual-instance count

initial_I_reuse_contract.same_canonical_case_id_rule: I/{split}/{renderer_id}/Dock.body_size.base/{suite_id}; stage refers to the same canonical registered case and original evidence, never a relabeled different capture
initial_I_reuse_contract.hash_field_rule: Every *_sha256 must be a resolved64hex frozen artifact binding, not a placeholder or hash of an arbitrary label. Resolve/bind every identity field before capture/reuse. Draft references are not proof.
initial_I_reuse_contract.comparison: All required identity fields must be present, resolved and exactly equal between the initial observed-case condition record and scheduled frozen-case condition record before subtracting a reused slot. All original capture/frame/action support stays attached. A mismatch or incomplete/unsupported evidence cannot silently satisfy full coverage.
initial_I_reuse_contract.actual_delivery_policy: Native/Android and separate recordings preserve independent actual delivery/response traces with clock support. Do not require actual trajectories or delivery timings equal, force them to match, or put actual response into the input identity. Requested action/intents, driver/build and condition bindings must match.
initial_I_reuse_contract.scope: Exact reuse is conditional on full identity and usable action/frame evidence. Lost reuse adds at most28 nominal core slots under a finite stage ledger; atomic splits and one bounded incomplete-action followup remain separately counted.
initial_I_reuse_contract.actual_instance_identity_policy: expected_semantic_component_manifest_sha256 binds the frozen expected semantic/layout/component-target plan, not future native object IDs or observed lifetime union. Actual native object IDs, observed instance union/generations, late discovery and creation/destruction intervals are independent capture evidence bound after capture. Reuse retains the same original evidence; actual object IDs need not match between renderers or independent captures.

native_component_instance_contract.status: registry_method_declaration_only; no actual native instance inventory registered
native_component_instance_contract.template_vs_instance: The37 family.component entries are category templates, not37 total observed instances. Expand to actual persistent semantic/native instance targets before capture. One row_body or glyphs_labels row cannot stand in for5 menu rows or multiple Tab items/buttons/ticks.
native_component_instance_contract.content_cardinality_binding: Register expected semantic item/action/tick/content IDs and ordering from controlled native configuration. Enumerate every menu row, Dock/Tab item foreground, slider tick/label and dialog/sheet action button separately; bind each instance to its parent and item/action/tick/content ID. One generic class row cannot satisfy those cardinalities.
native_component_instance_contract.identity_lifetime: Persistent IDs within an observed instance lifetime; a destroyed/recreated popup/button/row gets a new generation/episode. Never assert object continuity from the same class/index alone. Public object identity may be unavailable; retain null and semantic correspondence method/uncertainty instead of private API.
native_component_instance_contract.every_frame_expected_instances: Every recorded frame must have exactly one row for every registered instance target in the clip union registry, with explicit not_created_yet,present,not_in_native_api,not_exposed,not_visible,occluded,clipped,unidentified,ended,decode_failed statuses. Registry expansion/late discovery is versioned and preserves its creation interval; no rows disappear just because a menu closes. Never pool distinct row/button instances or drop repeats/failures.
native_component_instance_contract.parent_layer_binding: All edge,corner,pose,opacity/fill/source-deformation and material-ancestor rows bind to component_instance_id, parent instance ID and frame clock support, including nested presentation buttons and item highlight/fill. Category aggregates may supplement, never replace instance evidence.
native_component_instance_contract.scope: Protocol instance-inventory/frame-cardinality method only. A synthetic metadata checker is not real native inventory, geometric completeness, optical tracking or action coverage.
native_component_instance_contract.structural_absence_policy: Separate verified structurally_not_applicable/nonexistent for the actual native subtype from expected-present-but-unidentified/unexposed/null. Example: a native dialog without a sheet grabber is an inventory N/A, not a fabricated node or a measured grabber. Register applicable expected instances and structural exclusions separately. Legitimate precreation/ended/not-visible lifecycle absence is retained, not treated as present measurement.
native_component_instance_contract.measurement_gate_scope: Inventory completeness may include verified subtype N/A and legitimate lifecycle absence. Full geometry/appearance measurement requires support for every applicable expected-present instance/frame; unidentified/null is not a pass. N/A is a documented exclusion, never a successful measurement or an all-subtypes claim.
native_component_instance_contract.independent_expected_semantic_manifest: Register controlled content/layout semantic target manifest independently of observed instance rows: semantic_target_id, component_template_id, item/action/tick/content binding, structural applicability/exclusion evidence and expected generation/instance multiplicity for the finite registered clip inventory where established. Actual instance union must cover that manifest, not define its own expected language/Tab/action/tick set. Extra/unexpected or missing/pooled semantic bindings remain failures; unknown multiplicity remains unresolved, not a pass.
native_component_instance_contract.independent_frame_ledger: Bind exact original actual-frame sequence IDs and PTS from the acquisition/decode ledger, including failure/repeat rows. Frame list must be nonempty and match every actual ID/PTS in order without omission, duplication, replacement or unsupported interpolation. A registry-relative empty frame set cannot pass.
native_component_instance_contract.lifecycle_terminal_rule: For an instance ID+generation, ended is terminal: no later present/active state for the same generation. A recreation receives a new generation/instance ID and creation interval. Preserve decode_failed/unknown rows without erasing known ended state. Precreation cannot follow a known active lifetime. Public identity/correspondence uncertainty remains explicit.
native_component_instance_contract.observed_inventory_timing: Freeze expected semantic/content/layout targets before capture. Actual object identities, generation counts and union inventory can only be observed during/after capture; preserve/version/hash-bind them as independent evidence before analysis/reuse. The scalar metadata checker accepts an independently bound completed expected-inventory reconciliation for its synthetic finite fixture; it does not discover native objects or demand future object IDs at pre-capture freeze.
